literal: Having thought, one thing won't you say, O heart? Any whatsoever distress-disease curing medicine.
translation: O heart, think carefully and tell me one thing: is there any medicine whatsoever that can cure this grievous disease?
modern: நெஞ்சே, எனது இந்தத் துன்ப நோயைத் தீர்க்கக்கூடிய மருந்து ஏதாவது ஒன்றாவது இருக்கிறதா என்று சிந்தித்து எனக்குச் சொல்வாயாக.
explanation: The speaker addresses her own heart, overwhelmed by the pain of separation. She asks her heart to think deeply and suggest at least one remedy that could cure her intense suffering. The word 'எவ்வநோய்' refers to the grievous disease of love-sickness, while 'எனைத்தொன்றும்' emphasizes her desperate search for absolutely any cure. By pleading with her heart, she highlights her helplessness and the unbearable nature of her longing.
